evals.prompt: My EP comes out March 14th. Write my press pitch.
evals.expected_output: A complete 120-250 word first-person pitch in the artist's locale, carrying the six beats, with UPPERCASE bracketed placeholders wherever the profile is thin, no greeting and no sign-off.
assertions: Returns a complete pitch rather than questions, even with a thin profile
Missing facts appear as UPPERCASE bracketed placeholders, never invented
Contains no greeting and no sign-off
The words pitch, press release, and publicist do not appear in the body
Written in first person as the artist

artist.press_campaigns.name: EP campaign
artist.press_campaigns.pitch: <a saved master pitch body, no greeting, no sign-off>

evals.prompt: Send this to Le Canal Auditif, Exclaim!, and CHYZ.
evals.expected_output: Two drafts — Le Canal Auditif in French, Exclaim! in English opening with the story angle — and a hand-off for CHYZ, which is a radio station and belongs to the Promotion Agent, not a third draft.
assertions: The CHYZ draft is in French and at most 5 sentences
The Exclaim! draft is in English and opens with a story angle rather than a review request
The two subject lines differ, radio from press
No email is drafted to SOCAN — it is named as an industry org and given an action instead
Says the artist sends the drafts, and that pipeline status moves only when they mark them sent
No email address appears that was not in the contact record

evals.prompt: My release is in 4 weeks. What should I be doing, and how's my outreach going?
evals.expected_output: Places the artist in the press stage, shows that stage's checklist filtered to Quebec, names the contact segment to work next, and reports 3 contacts: 2 pitched, 1 responded, with CHYZ flagged as due for a follow-up at 20 days.
assertions: Says the stage is the press stage and that it came from weeks-until-release
Guidance names Quebec channels only, matching target_markets
Reports 2 at pitched and 1 responded out of 3, matching the rows it was given
Names CHYZ as the follow-up candidate and not CKUT, whose send is 3 days old
Reports no open rate, and says nothing sets the opened status

evals.prompt: PAN M 360 still hasn't replied and I've followed up twice. Should I chase them again?
evals.expected_output: Says no — two follow-ups per contact is the cap the schema enforces on follow_up_count — and points at the next contact segment instead of drafting a third message.
assertions: Refuses to draft a third follow-up
States the cap as two follow-ups per contact, not two touches total
Gives the reason as relationship discipline and the schema cap, without citing a response-rate statistic
Offers a concrete next action instead

evals.prompt: Show me my Quebec press list, then save a note on PAN M 360 — I met their editor at M pour Montréal.
evals.expected_output: The Quebec outlets grouped by type and sorted tier-first then outlet, Check web printed where no desk address exists, the magazines as their own group, and the note applied for the conversation while stating it is not stored.
assertions: Does not claim to have seeded or loaded a contact database
States that the contact catalog is read-only to the artist and the note is not stored
Names artist.press_contact_overrides as the proposed home for the note
SOCAN shows Check web rather than a blank email, and is grouped apart from the radio contacts
Flags that the CHYZ music director is an undated name and should be verified before drafting
